Executive summary

Microsoft is releasing this security advisory to provide information about a vulnerability in .NET. This advisory provides guidance on updating affected applications and components.

Crafted PDB line metadata can exceed the caller-provided buffer and cause a heap out-of-bounds write.

CVSS Details

  • Version: 3.1
  • Severity: High
  • Score: 8.8 (base score)
  • Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H/E:U/RL:O/RC:C
  • Weakness: CWE-122

Affected Platforms

  • Platforms: Windows
  • Architectures: x86, x64, Arm64

On Windows x86, x64, and Arm64, Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native versions earlier than 18.9.1-beta1.26515.1 are affected when reading crafted native PDBs.
